geometry: Preserve the exact square canvas, flat-top hex footprint, camera, scale, deep tapered island, centered recessed front stairs, and transparent padding.
Keep one small circular standing patch in the lower third, horizontally centered immediately above the front stairs.
The standing patch is only large enough for the Katchimera, connects to the stairs with at most one broad stepping stone, and remains at the same anchor in every stage.
Keep the middle readable while allowing the environment to grow naturally around the lower standing patch.
style: Chunky rounded clay-like forms, broad soft bevels, matte simplified materials, low-frequency surfaces, warm diffuse light, and clean silhouettes.
Every important feature must remain readable at 256 pixels.
persistentLandmarks: The unfinished twig-and-leaf shelter at rear-left matures in place into the signature enchanted leaf home.
The simple pond remains anchored at left while its water and planting become richer.
The stump seat and two botanical lanterns remain anchored at rear-right.
The same moss-capped rocks persist while their moss and flowers mature.
The small lower-center character standing patch remains open at every stage.

stages.name: Forgotten Clearing
stages.floor: Broad warm bare-soil masses cover most of the floor, broken by sparse muted moss with no granular texture.
stages.landmark: An unfinished low twig-and-loose-leaf shelter frame at rear-left.
props: a shallow simple pond at left
a plain low stump at rear-right

stages.name: First Garden
stages.narrative: The player helps Mossprout establish somewhere to grow.
stages.floor: Warm earth still covers much of the floor while larger healthy moss patches begin reconnecting.
stages.landmark: The same rear-left shelter has a stable arched twig frame and one incomplete layer of broad leaves.
stages.density: Modest beginner garden with large readable shapes.

stages.name: Garden Nook
stages.narrative: Mossprout begins treating the place as home.
stages.floor: Healthy lawn and moss cover most of the floor while two or three broad earth remnants remain.
stages.landmark: The same rear-left shelter is now a complete established layered-leaf home.
props: the same clean blue pond at left
the established rounded stump chair at rear-right

stages.name: Flourishing Woodland
stages.narrative: Mossprout helps the surrounding clearing come back to life.
stages.floor: Rich continuous forest moss with a calm middle and the small lower standing patch kept clear.
stages.landmark: The same rear-left leaf home flourishes with fuller leaves, modest vines, and a few flower buds.
props: two lily pads in the same left pond
stages.lighting: Filtered woodland daylight with restrained warm lantern light.
stages.density: Rich and flourishing, using only a few large forms.

stages.name: Enchanted Grove
stages.narrative: Mossprout's home reaches its definitive magical form.
stages.floor: Deep smooth forest moss with the luminous left pond and the small lower standing patch kept clear.
stages.landmark: The same rear-left shelter is now the signature enchanted leaf home with restrained flowers, vines, and warm hanging lights.
props: the same luminous lily pond at left
mature mossy rocks and luminous perimeter plants
stages.lighting: Soft woodland daylight with restrained mint magic and warm amber accents.
